reason: The node's description of the channel steps does not match the paper. The node says step (i) is 'Apply double Schur transform Schur^{dr} to rho^{tensor n}' but the paper's channel (Figure in purifychan.tex) applies only Schur^d in step 1, then manually constructs the Y', P', Q' registers in steps 3-5, and applies the inverse double Schur transform (Schur^d tensor Schur^r)^dag in step 6. The notation 'Schur^{dr}' is ambiguous (could mean the single D=dr Schur transform or the double Schur^d tensor Schur^r), and applying a double Schur transform at step 1 would require having B-registers already present in the input, which contradicts the fact that the input is rho^{tensor n} on d-dimensional registers only. The theorem conclusion is correct but the channel description is inaccurate.
